newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks dive on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks dive on profit-taking.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dived before the close on Friday on profit-taking ahead of the Saturday and Sunday weekend, dealers said.

A Fortune Securities dealer attributed the fall to profit-taking after sharp increases in the stock prices in the past few sessions and said profit-taking would continue till the close. The Karachi 100-index fell 52.31 points, or 2.63 percent, to 1,937.20 in two hours of trading at 11.30 a.m. (0630 GMT). Losers led gainers 128 to 12.
Pakistan Telecom PTCA.KA fell 1.40 rupees to 38.20 and Hub Power 1.75 to 55. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
